Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_EnableSleepSh: Prevent sleeping in pre-made buildings and vehicles. Players can sleep outdoors, in a tent, or in a player-built structure.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_StartingItems: Choose the equipment supplied to new characters.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_CompassOpensM: Require a compass on player to display the minimap.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_EnableRPGSess: Allow nearby players carrying dice to gain mood benefits while an RPG Manual is being read.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_RPGSessionRan: Maximum distance in tiles from the reader for players carrying dice to participate.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_RPGSessionInt: Minutes between RPG Session mood benefits.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_RPGSessionUnh: Unhappiness removed from each participant at every interval.
Sandbox_WildernessSurvivor_RPGSessionStr: Stress removed from each participant at every interval.
